label: Кнопка CTA (w280, оранжевая)
description: table.w280 с td.butt и a.butt-link — фирменная оранжевая кнопка 233.
pug:
table.iq-cta-w280--w280.iq-cta-w280(align="{{ align }}" role="presentation")
    tr
        td.butt.iq-cta-w280--butt.pb0
            a.iq-cta-w280--butt-link(href="{{ href }}" universal="true" target="_blank") {{ label }}
styl:
.iq-cta-w280--w280
  width 100%
  max-width 280px
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    max-width 100% !important
.iq-cta-w280--butt
  background-size cover
  background-color #FF7700
  font-size 18px !important
  font-weight 700 !important
  border-radius: 16px !important
  text-transform: none
  font-family: Helvetica !important
  height auto
.iq-cta-w280--butt-link
  font-size 18px
  line-height 27px
  font-weight 700
  text-transform none
  text-decoration: none
  color #F9F9F9
  display block
  padding: 16px 0 16px
  text-align center
  letter-spacing 0px
